conclusion.safetensors_vs_tfold: BIT-IDENTICAL end-to-end (identical bf16 logit dump sha256 across all 5 scenarios)
conclusion.narrowing_declared: 18 FP32 linear_attn.norm.weight tensors narrowed f32 -> bf16 via core.bf16_round.bits (RNE) at load, max_abs <= 3.90625e-3, max_rel <= 3.89e-3, all finite
conclusion.unavoidable_conversion: gdn_post CUDA kernel's NW parameter is __nv_bfloat16* (kernels/cuda/qwen35.cu:385); FP32 weights cannot flow through unless the kernel signature changes. This is reported, not hidden.
